caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jar with a wide open mouth and a slightly flared rim. The jar is rendered in shades of warm beige and brown, giving it an earthenware appearance. Faint horizontal lines encircle the top portion of the jar, marking its neck. There is blue decorative painting on the side of the jar showing a stylized flower with a curved stem, two leaves, and a blossom composed of circular shapes. There is text near the rim of the jar, appearing to be printed or stamped in a blocky font. The jar is positioned upright and is the sole object within the composition, against a plain, light tan background. The artist’s signature, "J. Tarantino," appears in small script in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
